plan.rationale: This operation explicitly supports parsing category mappings to left, middle, and right baskets and executing visually grounded grasp-and-place actions. RGB shows three open baskets and pepper, car, and wooden-toy objects, matching the requested placement geometry. Its observation-batch input and end-effector action-chunk output fit the configured library contracts. Unlike visual-attribute-placement, it preserves language-specified destinations rather than assigning baskets by transfer cost. The subsequent arm reset is a shared lifecycle action.
